newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish govt on target to eliminate borrowing - Finmin.
newsitem.headline: Irish govt on target to eliminate borrowing - Finmin.

text.p: Irish Finance Minister Charlie McCreevy said Wednesday's Exchequer returns data showed the government was on course to meet its target of eliminating borrowing in two to three years.
McReevy told state broadcaster RTE that the data provided "positive signs."
"We should be in a position to puruse our ohjective of eliminating the excherquer borrowing requirement over the next two to three years," he said.
